<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4H1Mzs/wbwriter/main/Assets/logo-mark-1024.png" width="72" align="right" alt="WBWriter">

### What's new

- **Corner logo.** A small, faint logo now sits in the bottom-right corner of the touchscreen. If the clear button is in that corner, the logo moves above it, or beside it when the board leaves no room. It never covers the board, ignores touches, and is never sent to NDI® or HDMI.
- **Choose your own logo.** In the setup window, **Corner logo** can be 4H1M (the default), **Custom image** (pick any image file, a white logo on a transparent background works best), or **None**.

### Download

If you have WBWriter 1.1.1 or later, it offers this update by itself at launch. Otherwise download **`WBWriter-1.2.0.dmg`** (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized), open it and drag WBWriter into Applications.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.
